connection_pooling.findings: Global persistent clients created for Qdrant, Redis, httpx.AsyncClient, STTSessionManager, and TTSSessionManager on app startup in main.py.

websocket_lifecycle.findings: Explicit connect, configure, stream, partial_flush, barge_in, and disconnect cleanup handlers implemented in ws_voice.py and stt_session.py.

cancellation_and_barge_in.findings: TurnManager handles turn_id tracking, cancelling active TTS audio streaming and LLM generation when new speech or barge-in signal arrives.

memory_leak_prevention.findings: Bounded LRU cache, explicit WebSocket cleanup, and MediaStreamTrack release handlers enforced.

language_mapping.findings: Canonical BCP-47 / Sarvam language code mapping: hi-IN (Hindi), gu-IN (Gujarati), bn-IN (Bengali), ta-IN (Tamil), en-IN (English).
